papers.title_en: Residual Pseudospectra Reveal a Physics-Informed Koopman Backbone for Tropical Pacific Variability and ENSO Prediction
papers.authors: Paula Lorenzo-Sanchez, Matthew J. Colbrook, Antonio Navarra
papers.tldr: 热带太平洋海温变率涉及多尺度相互作用，ENSO是其主导年际信号。Koopman算子学习可提取非线性动力学的谱坐标，但有限观测常产生密集且物理意义模糊的谱。本文结合核扩展动态模式分解、残差最小化和伪谱分析，将Koopman特征值关系作为物理一致性检验，从ERA5和HadISST数据中识别出19个稳健残差最小频率及其相干空间模态，构成紧凑的“库普曼骨干”，涵盖低频调制至准两年分量。该骨干重构Nino3.4方差显著，并在8-18个月提前期提升预报技巧，将动力学一致性嵌入物理信息算子学习，使模糊谱变为可解释的预测性表征。
papers.abstract_en: Tropical Pacific sea-surface-temperature (SST) variability spans interacting timescales, with the ENSO as its dominant interannual expression. Yet the dynamical structure organizing this variability and underpinning extended-range predictability remains difficult to extract from high-dimensional observations. Koopman operator learning offers spectral coordinates for nonlinear dynamics, yet finite geophysical records often produce dense, sampling-sensitive spectra whose physical content is ambiguous. We show that this apparent redundancy reflects coherent operator-level structure. Combining kernel Extended Dynamic Mode Decomposition with residual minimization and pseudospectral analysis, we use the Koopman eigenvalue relation as a physics-informed consistency test to organize learned spectra. Applied to ERA5 and HadISST tropical Pacific SST anomalies, the residual landscape identifies 19 robust residual-minimum frequencies with coherent spatial modes that persist across products and sampling realizations. Together, these modes define a compact Koopman backbone spanning low-frequency modulation through quasi-biennial components, including ENSO-band variability. The surrounding spectral cloud is structured by integer powers and nonlinear combinations of this backbone, forming a residual-ordered Koopman hierarchy. The backbone reconstructs substantial Nino3.4 variance and enables skillful out-of-sample forecasts, with greatest gains at 8-18-month leads. By embedding dynamical consistency into physics-informed operator learning, the framework turns opaque spectra into robust, interpretable and predictive representations of tropical Pacific variability.

papers.title_en: Data-driven surrogate models for forecasting experimentally measured fluid flows
papers.authors: Peter I. Renn, Emily H. Palmer, Cong Wang, Morteza Gharib
papers.evidence: 基于神经网络的数据驱动代理模型预测流体流动
papers.tldr: 基于数据驱动的代理模型可用于流体流动的实时预报，但真实工程中测量数据有限且不完美。本文使用二维PIV测量数据，训练F-CNN、U-Net、FNO和DMD等模型，预测圆柱尾流速度场。结果表明，模型可在短时内有效预测，传播低频动态且快于实时，但难以保持瞬态特征和高频能量。本研究揭示了真实复杂流动中数据驱动建模面临的主要挑战。
papers.abstract_en: Data-driven modeling shows significant promise for faster-than-real-time forecasting of fluid flows. For real-world engineering applications (e.g., flow control), models must contend with limited, imperfect, and incomplete experimental measurements. In this work, we present an analysis of data-driven surrogate models trained to forecast the time-evolution of experimentally measured cylinder wakes in the subcritical vortex shedding regime. Using a dataset of two-dimensional, two-component particle image velocimetry measurements, we train fully convolutional neural networks, U-Nets, Fourier neural operators, and dynamic mode decomposition-based models to forecast the development of experimentally measured velocity fields. To characterize data-driven approaches contending with transient flow features and limited, imperfect observations, the development of predictions over extended forecast horizons is examined at a fixed Reynolds number (Re = 590). Next, models are trained at a range of Reynolds numbers (Re = 230 to Re = 2920) to investigate the impact of increasingly turbulent and three-dimensional flow phenomena, and the challenges associated with measuring them, on forecast quality. We find that experimentally trained surrogate models can provide meaningful predictions over short time horizons, propagate low-frequency dynamics over longer forecast periods, and achieve faster-than-real-time evaluation. However, the data-driven models struggle to preserve transient flow features and high-frequency energy content when faced with noisy measurements and incomplete state observations. This emphasizes the underlying challenges that remain for data-driven modeling approaches to effectively contend with fluid dynamics in real-world engineering applications, where observations are often imperfect and limited.

papers.title_en: Weibull-Stationary Stochastic Differential Equations for Conditional Long-Horizon Wind Power Forecasting
papers.evidence: 基于随机微分方程的风速数据用于风力发电预测
papers.tldr: 针对月度风功率概率预测问题，本文基于Weibull参数建模和随机微分方程，提出了一种十分钟分辨率的一月前条件概率框架。通过Godambe协方差校正串行依赖的SCADA风速数据，用异方差卡尔曼滤波预测Weibull参数，并构建三种正风速SDE模型。应用XGBoost功率曲线，在Kelmarsh风电场数据上验证，三种模型概率精度相近，但扩散优先模型计算效率高7倍。能量偏差约-7.3%，超越概率误差低于1.6个百分点，为下游运营问题提供决策相关概率输入。
papers.abstract_en: We present a one-month-ahead conditional probabilistic framework for wind-power forecasting at ten-minute resolution. Monthly Weibull shape and scale parameters are estimated from serially dependent SCADA wind-speed data, corrected through a Godambe covariance, and forecast by a heteroskedastic Kalman filter on a bivariate VAR(1) state-space model. Conditional on the MMSE forecasted Weibull invariant law, we construct and compare three positive wind-speed SDE models: an Ornstein-Uhlenbeck-Weibull transform, a Fokker-Planck drift-first diffusion, and a Fokker-Planck diffusion-first model. The simulated wind-speed ensembles are mapped to power through a calibrated XGBoost power curve. Applied to January 2021 data from a Senvion MM92 turbine at Kelmarsh Wind Farm, the three SDE formulations are statistically indistinguishable in probabilistic accuracy, with mean CRPS values between 1.569 and 1.575 m/s. The diffusion-first model is therefore preferred on computational grounds, reducing runtime by about a factor of seven relative to the OU-Weibull model. In the power domain, the Wasserstein distance between simulated and observed distributions is 26.1-27.6 kW, below $1.4\%$ of rated capacity, while the monthly energy-yield bias is about $-7.3\%$ for the examined month. Exceedance-probability errors remain below 1.6 percentage points over the 0-1500 kW range and about 2.2 percentage points near rated power. These quantities provide decision-relevant probabilistic inputs for downstream operational problems, rather than completed reserve, storage, market, or fatigue-optimization decisions. Full marginalisation over the Kalman predictive law of the Weibull parameters is left as a natural extension.

papers.title_en: Drifting Models for Surrogate Flow Modeling
papers.authors: Chris R. Jung, Markus Dörr, Natalie Jüngling, Jennifer Niessner, Adam T. Müller, Nicolaj C. Stache
papers.evidence: 漂移生成框架用于替代流建模，类似于用于超分辨率的扩散模型
papers.tldr: 计算流体动力学（CFD）虽能精确模拟流场，但计算成本高昂，限制了设计空间的快速探索。现有生成式代理模型（如扩散模型）虽优于确定性网络，但迭代采样速度慢。本文引入生成式漂移框架，在变分自编码器潜空间中进行条件漂移，并利用标签感知掩码对齐边界条件，实现了单次前向生成高质量流场。该方法在精度和流一致性上与迭代扩散模型相当，但推理速度快两个数量级。此外，提出的空间条件变体展现了向未见几何体泛化的潜力，为实时CFD代理提供了高效替代方案。
papers.abstract_en: While Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) provides high-fidelity flow fields for optimizing indoor environments, its computational cost limits rapid exploration. To solve this problem generative surrogates offer better distribution modeling than deterministic networks, but iterative sampling is slow. To enable high-quality, single-pass generation, we adapt the novel generative drifting framework to fluid mechanics. We introduce a conditional architecture that performs drifting in a learned VAE latent space and uses label-aware masking to align generated samples with their boundary conditions. Our label-conditioned model matches iterative diffusion in accuracy and flow consistency while running two orders of magnitude faster. Additionally, we propose a spatial-conditioning variant that establishes a promising path towards generalization to unseen geometries. Ultimately, conditional drifting serves as a highly efficient alternative to diffusion based approaches, unlocking real-time CFD surrogates where inference speed is critical.

papers.title_en: Crop Recommendation and Agricultural Query Answering System Using Spatio-Temporal Graph Neural Networks and Hybrid Retrieval Augmentation
papers.evidence: 使用时空图神经网络进行天气预报
papers.tldr: 针对尼泊尔农村农民缺乏个性化农业指导的问题，本文提出统一系统，使用STGCN模型对1359个地点进行30天天气预报（MSE仅0.011），结合土壤属性通过评分算法推荐作物；同时开发基于RAG的农业问答聊天机器人。系统以移动应用形式部署，用户反馈表明其能提供实时建议，有助于提升作物产量和应对气候变异。
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents a unified system designed to support precision agriculture by integrating advanced weather prediction, crop recommendation, and a question-answering tool for farmers. We propose two deep learning models -- a Transformer-based Graph Neural Network and a Spatio-Temporal Graph Convolutional Network (STGCN) -- to forecast weather conditions for the next 30 days using data from 1,359 locations in Nepal. The STGCN outperforms the Transformer-based model in accuracy (MSE ~0.011 vs. 0.013), effectively modeling both spatial and temporal dependencies in climate data. These predictions are combined with static soil properties such as pH, moisture, and organic content to generate localized crop recommendations through a scoring algorithm that matches each crop's optimal growing conditions. Additionally, we develop a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) chatbot that leverages domain-specific agricultural documents to answer farmers' questions in natural language. The entire system is deployed via a mobile application, offering real-time suggestions and conversational support. User feedback confirms the system's usability and relevance, especially in rural settings where personalized farming guidance is limited. Overall, our approach demonstrates how combining machine learning models with local agricultural data can empower farmers with actionable insights, promoting more informed decisions, better crop yields, and increased resilience to climate variability.

papers.title_en: LangRetrieval: Language-Guided Self-Evolving Satellite-to-Radar Retrieval via CSI-Driven Reward
papers.authors: Chunlei Shi, Junming Hou, Yi-Lin Wei, Jiong Wang, Yecheng Zhang, Yichao Dong, Wenqi Ren, Dan Niu
papers.evidence: 卫星到雷达降水估计，可视为气象降尺度/超分辨率
papers.tldr: 卫星到雷达（S2R）降水检索任务中，相似云顶亮温可能对应不同降水，现有静态语义引导不足。本文提出LangRetrieval框架，通过语言引导的条件流匹配（CFM），利用视觉语言模型初始化语义属性，并采用多阈值临界成功指数（CSI）奖励通过群组相对策略优化（GRPO）自进化语义生成，实现检索闭环优化。该方法在雷达稀疏区显著提升降水反演精度，为卫星遥感与语言模型的融合提供新范式。
papers.abstract_en: Satellite-to-radar (S2R) retrieval estimates ground radar precipitation from geostationary satellite observations, providing a critical solution for precipitation monitoring in radar-sparse regions. However, S2R retrieval is intrinsically ill-posed: similar cloud-top radiances can correspond to distinct precipitation regimes, storm organizations, and surface intensities, which are difficult to uniquely determine the underlying meteorological state from local spectral cues alone. Meteorological semantics offer complementary scene-level information that can help resolve this ambiguity. Yet existing static semantic conditioning is often insufficient, as externally predefined semantics cannot adapt to dynamic convective scenes or align with retrieval objectives. To this end, we propose LangRetrieval, a language-guided conditional flow matching (CFM) framework that establishes a closed-loop optimization mechanism between meteorological semantics and retrieval accuracy. Specifically, LangRetrieval consists of two core components: (i) Semantic Warm-up: structured meteorological attributes are injected into the CFM backbone through cross-attention conditioning, enabling continuous semantic guidance throughout the generation trajectory; and (ii) Self-Evolving Semantic Optimization: a lightweight attribute policy is first initialized from vision-language model annotations and subsequently refined via Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) using multi-threshold Critical Success Index (CSI) rewards, enabling semantic generation to evolve directly toward improved retrieval accuracy.

papers.title_en: Data-driven surrogate models for forecasting experimentally measured fluid flows
papers.authors: Peter I. Renn, Emily H. Palmer, Cong Wang, Morteza Gharib
papers.evidence: 数据驱动代理模型用于流体流动预测，可应用于数值天气预报
papers.tldr: 数据驱动的代理模型在流体力学预报中具有潜力，但面临实验测量数据有限、含噪和不完整等挑战。本研究利用圆柱尾流实验数据，训练了全卷积神经网络、U-Net、傅里叶神经算子及动态模态分解模型，在亚临界涡脱落状态下预报速度场。结果显示模型能在短时内提供有意义预测并实现超实时计算，但难以保持瞬态特征和高频能量，凸显了真实应用中的难点。

papers.authors: Zhengkai Pan, Peter Potaptchik, Wenxi Yao, Michael S. Albergo, Jakiw Pidstrigach
papers.evidence: 面向生成模型的任意步随机微分方程流映射
papers.tldr: 现有一步生成模型依赖确定性ODE，难以处理随机动力学。本文提出Itô映射，是一种任意步随机流映射，接受中间状态和布朗路径，单次前向预测未来状态。基于此，设计新的推断时控制估计器，可廉价获取可微后验样本。实验表明，Itô映射能从固定中间状态生成多样、条件有效端点样本，在合成和图像生成基准上实现强引导性能。该工作将任意步SDE集成确立为后验采样和随机控制的有用原语。
papers.abstract_en: Recent one-step generative models accelerate sampling by learning deterministic flow maps of the underlying dynamics. These methods rely on learning from ordinary differential equations, leaving open how to define an exact distillation procedure for stochastic dynamics. We introduce the Itô map, an any-step stochastic flow map that takes an intermediate state and Brownian path and predicts future states in a single pass. The Itô map formulation yields novel estimators for inference-time control by providing cheap, differentiable access to posterior samples. Empirically, Itô maps produce diverse, conditionally valid endpoint samples from fixed intermediate states and support strong steering performance on synthetic and image-generation benchmarks. These results establish any-step SDE integration as a useful primitive for posterior sampling and stochastic control.
